title: CURRENCY ( 3.6666666666666 ) is 3.6667: the fifth decimal rounds, it is not cut off

source.quote: Rounding up occurs if the 5th significant decimal is equal or larger than 5
source.supports: CURRENCY rounds on the fifth decimal; the page gives 3.6666666666666 as 3.6667 and 3.0123456789 as 3.0123

notes: Truncation would give 3.6666. This value is not a tie, so it separates rounding from truncation without depending on how a half is rounded.
